description: A monitor's runs, newest first: trigger (schedule or manual), status (queued, running, completed, failed, cancelled) and fail_reason, the window it searched, item_count, stats per source (fetched, in_window, new, passed, error, accounts_failed and hashtags_failed: watched accounts and hashtags that could not be read; the source fails only when all of them do) and how items were screened (stats.screen: ai, by an AI classifier, or keyword when it fell back), summary, reserved_usd, and cost_usd (null until billed). Free. Returns { runs, next_cursor }; next_cursor is null on the last page.

monitor_id.description: monitor_id returned by monitor-create or monitor-list, example: '6f1d0c9e-0d55-4b8e-9a3c-3c4d9b8e2a10'.

name: monitor-runs
title: List Monitor Runs
